# On and off by default — the `security-html` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#security-html).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** never — a security pack is chosen, not detected.
- **Rules:** 19 — 0 on, 0 on with `preview = true`, 19 off in an opt-in preset, 0 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `sec-html/recommended` | no — opt in | 19 | 19 error | html/security and the high-confidence HTML security rules, at error |
| `sec-html/strict` | no — opt in | 24 | 19 error, 5 warn | sec-html/recommended and the heuristic HTML security rules, at warn |

## Rules

`on` runs in a fresh install; a `preview` rule runs only with `preview = true` ([SR-RULE-PACKS](../../../records/0101_rule-packs.md) decision 9). † a preset `init` writes only when the repo has what it is for.
